name: Rudianus

attributes.attribute: an obscure Continental Celtic god in France
identified by Romans with the warrior Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rudianus is a Continental Celtic god. He is a dim figure known only from a few stones in France that called on his help. Romans linked him with their warrior god Mars.

okr.objective: Present Rudianus as an obscure Continental Celtic god linked to Mars.
key_results: He is known only from a few inscriptions in France.
The inscriptions asked for his help.
Romans saw him as their warrior god Mars.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
